This is a compilation of the artist's illustrations that have not yet been released digitally or that are not entirely public.
This gallery will be updated over the coming months as I continue to edit the raw scanned images (taken from illustration books released from 2022 to the present).
(P.S.: Since most of the illustrations are scanned images, the update schedule and the number of illustrations uploaded over time may vary depending on the complexity of the editing process)

The illustrations included here are and will be:
- Illustrations that have never been or have not yet been released digitally.
- “Revised” versions of older illustrations.
- Unreleased variations of illustration sets.
- Illustrations that have been published digitally but privately.
- Very high-quality versions of public illustrations (which are behind a paywall).

Updates:

- March 2026 Update (03/18/2026): 6 new illustrations have been added in total.

- April 2026 Updates: (04/07/2026 to 04/30/2026): 48 new illustrations have been added in total (+57 public illustrations in their highest quality and changes in the sorting of the images).

- May 2026 Updates (05/02/26 to 05/11/26): 12 new illustrations have been added and 9 have received slight changes (corrections) (+8 public illustrations in their highest quality).
